title: Birth under a veil and seeing spirits as a toddler
summary: She was born with a veil, in a place thought to have been a Civil War cemetery, and saw a white dog turn into a cow. Her mother thought she was seeing spirits.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Mary, let's get back to when you were born in Atlanta. Tell me about the circumstances of the place where you were born.

Well, I used to hear my parents speak of the land where the house was built. It seems that it was a sunken cemetery of soldiers of the Civil War and then at the time I was born - there was a midwife brought me into the world - I was born like with a veil. I guess this was a superstition but we were living in a neighborhood of a lot of superstitious people down South. This midwife told my mother that I was born with a veil over my eyes and for her to save this veil and dry it out and she could tell when I was sick and all that. I used to hear so many stories about spooks and ghosts and everything. Seemed like I picked up on that when I was about two or three years old because my mother was afraid to take me out anywhere with us. She said that one day we were walking in the field and I saw a little white dog and the white dog grew into a cow. I said, 'Come on down, Mother,' but she ran and left me but she came back. Everybody was afraid to be around me because I was seeing so many weird things.
When you saw the little white dog grow into a cow, did it?

It certainly did. I remember that. My Mother said it's amazing some of the things I used to see and some of the things I remember when I was two years old. It seems that I was playing with this little white dog
and she didn't pay any attention to it. I reached up and said, 'Oh, it's a cow,' or something like that. She ran but she said she came back and picked me up and took me home.
What did they do with the cow?

I guess it disappeared. But she said at an early age I was seeing spirits. I often wondered about a lot of other kids, you know, with their imagination. They are probably able to see them also. Because I've gone through life like that, seeing various things, except when I became Catholic - now I feel them more or less. I don't see them any more.
